sourceElementsReviewed: Three nested tenths/hundredths/thousandths number lines: accurately locate 0.001
richTitle: Compare Decimals on the Number Line
richSourceOverview: Original IM2021 G5 U05:L06 Compare Decimals on the Number Line: recognize NESTED number lines that zoom from a whole0–1 interval subdivided in TENTHS, to0–0.1 interval in HUNDREDTHS, to0–0.01 interval in THOUSANDTHS. A place value of a label depends on the specified scale and a correct number must sit at a mathematically consistent tick.

Warm-up Notice and Wonder Nested Lines: teacher supplies source three-line diagram and pupils explain how each entire lower line zooms into the first tick interval of the line above. Source given 0–1 by0.1;0–0.1 by0.01;0–0.01 by0.001. Original publisher figure positions and arrow placement are not independently reproduced from source image; teacher checks spatial interpretation.

Activity 1 Locate 1 Thousandth: students label ALL tick marks on each of the original number lines and indicate0.001. On the source fine-scale0–0.01 line,0.001 is the FIRST tick after zero. On a coarse line it is too small to coincide with the first full tenth/hundredth tick; learners explain where it would lie between original marks rather than falsely label 0.001 as0.01 or0.1.

Activity 2 Label and Compare Decimals: source asks pupils to choose which original line BEST compares0.534 and0.537. The thousandths differ, so a scale with step0.001 in the neighborhood of0.53 supports exact placement;0.534 <0.537. A separately authored zoomed line0.530–0.540 is a valid model but NOT stated to be one of the exact publisher line images.
